verdict.rationale: The pack documents a Persona REST API reference, an llms.txt index, and Markdown versions of doc pages, but nothing mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. llms.txt and Markdown pages are adjacent agent-friendly documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
